title: IV–V. Paternal chastisement for those looking to the womans seed; of the first parents and of posterity
pass_a_gloss: Pass A clause gloss (reordered): To posterity ye same were transmitted with original sin. labor, pain belonging toward childbirth, subjection, temporal death (Genesis 3:16-19) — expulsion out from paradise. On ye first parents were laid: And this stands as either belonging toward ye first parents or belonging toward posterity. V. And verses 28-29. who walk not according to ye flesh but according to ye Spirit — there stands as therefore now no condemnation toward those who stand as in Christ Jesus. Hence ye Apostle in Romans 8:1: toward sinners looking to ye blessed seed belonging toward ye woman, their old nature stands as reformed through a temporary cross after ye manner belonging toward an adult — paternal chastisement stands as that same by means belonging toward which. IV.
pass_b_english: IV. Paternal chastisement is that by which, for sinners looking to the blessed seed of the woman, their old nature is reformed through a temporary cross after the manner of an adult. Hence the Apostle in Romans 8:1: There is therefore now no condemnation for those who are in Christ Jesus, who walk not according to the flesh but according to the Spirit. And verses 28-29. V. And this is either of the first parents or of posterity. On the first parents were laid: expulsion from paradise, labor, pain of childbirth, subjection, temporal death (Genesis 3:16-19). To posterity the same were transmitted with original sin.
source_text: IV. Castigatio paterna est, qua peccatoribus ad benedictum semen mulieris respicientibus vetus ipsorum natura per crucem temporariam adultus instar reformatur. Hinc Apostolus Rom. 8:1: Nulla igitur nunc est condemnatio iis qui in Christo Iesu, qui non secundum carnem ambulant, sed secundum spiritum. Et v. 28-29. V. Est vero haec protoplastorum aut posterorum. Protoplastis irrogata sunt: expulsio e paradiso, labor, dolor partus, subiectio, mors temporalis (Gen. 3:16-19). Posteris eadem transmissae sunt cum originali peccato.
